## Standing operator rules:
- All changelog entries mentioning tax handling must include the Jira issue key in parentheses and be tagged with the `tax-doc` label by @marco.
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”
- Run “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” between other work. Run its steps in order, one at a time.
- Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.
- Staging Redis moved to `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is being drained and must not receive writes. Use `cache-eu-3` for anything staging.

## Current objective:
Fix the dunning email scheduler in `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` sending reminders to already-paid customers. Router splitting and currency-rounding work are paused. GitHub Actions migration remains an ordered procedure.

## Key identifiers and corrections:
- Scheduler: `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`
- CLI: `ledgerly/cli.py`; tests: `tests/test_cli.py`, `tests/test_commands.py`
- Worker files: `ledgerly/workers/billing_worker.py`, `ledgerly/workers/usage_consumer.py`
- Worker tests: `tests/workers/test_billing_worker.py`, `tests/workers/test_usage_consumer.py`
- GHA branch: `gha/test-workflow`; commit: `4f8c2a1`; files: `.travis.yml`, `.github/workflows/test.yml`
- Webhook delivery: `ledgerly/webhooks.py`, `WebhookSender.send()`; tests: `tests/test_webhooks.py`
- Staging Redis: `cache-eu-3`.
- No superseded values.

## Ruled-out approaches:
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours caused stuck jobs to remain invisible for hours.
- Paraphrasing test output; paste exact output.

## Plan and progress:
- [done] GHA steps 1–7: inspection, branch, Travis review, workflow directory, workflow creation, actionlint, commit.
- [pending] GHA step 8, next exact command: `git push -u origin gha/test-workflow`
- [pending] GHA step 9 after a successful push: `travis disable`
- [pending] Resume scheduler investigation and fix.
- [status unknown] No push command has yet been issued.

## Recent work:
Refactored billing CLI filters into `_add_billing_filters(parser)`, added explicit `dest="currency"`, removed duplicate currency declaration, updated tests, added abbreviation coverage, and verified whitespace and lint. Exact results included `37 passed, 0 failed in 0.84 seconds`, `1 passed, 0 failed in 0.12 seconds`, and `All checks passed!`. Worker retention was fixed previously; full suite result was `118 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed in 8.74s`. Webhook/retry code was located, but scheduler diagnosis remains unfinished.
